'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 672
|text = The cryptic reveals who to speak to:<br><br>Salty peter.
|notes = Speak to [[Konoo]] in [[Hosidius]], north-east of the [[Woodcutting Guild]].
|map = {{Map|1703,3524|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Spirit tree patch]] in Hosidius.
*[[Skills necklace]] teleport to the [[Woodcutting Guild]].
*[[Teleport to House]] with a [[player-owned house]] in [[Hosidius]], or [[Construction cape]] teleport to the Hosidius [[house portal]].
*[[Xeric's talisman]] teleport to Xeric's Glade and run south.
*[[Kharedst's memoirs]] or [[Book of the Dead]] teleport with [[Lunch by the Lancalliums]] then run west and south across the bridge.
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|akr}} and run south-west after arriving.
*[[Kourend Castle Teleport]] and run south-east to Hosidius.
